policy.anchor_selection: lowest SHA256(canonical key), first 4096 keys; all labels, no scores; unique count/direction/duration window before bytes/time
policy.clock_rule: integer-minute offset from metadata-unique window, residual within CSV precision (+/-2us numeric tolerance); CIC_IDS normalize 12h ambiguity, retain both offsets; no per-record fitting
policy.byte_rule: single domain metric from independent physical byte accounting; contradictory anchors count against consensus
policy.overflow_policy: disk spill, or fail stage/domain; never accept incomplete candidate searches
policy.prefix_policy: use verified complete-record prefix only; reject matching CSV uncertainty interval touching unavailable range, including overlaps supplied by another shard
policy.sample_input: official 77 unscaled float32 statistics; first512 bytes of anonymized frames, zero padded; no fitted preprocessing
policy.duplicate_policy: exclude ALL records in cross-label identical-input components; same-label hashes + sessions + uncertain continuation edges union before partition
policy.split_gate: no automatic training; require class/group feasibility and explicit episode/split protocol before manifest; no fabricated independence

session_rules.new_connection: new non-retransmitted SYN without ACK; idle expiry; or closure boundary excluding bounded control tail
session_rules.control_tail: after RST or both-direction FIN, no SYN, zero transport payload, within2s of closure; never extends original closure grace
session_rules.missing_handshake: retain with missing_initial_syn; no complete-connection claim
session_rules.packet_count_basis: one observed TCP/UDP packet is not invalid merely for being short; zero/negative counts invalid; large windows use chunking or fail-closed resource guard
session_rules.payload_metric_CIC_IDS: one certified metric per provenance domain, never per row or label: IP-bounded payload_len versus capture_payload_len including Ethernet padding
session_rules.payload_schema_scope: metadata-only anchor calibration; fixed diagnostic-derived schemas do not certify the whole capture; full source uses label-blind anchors and blocks mixed/unsupported schema
session_rules.timestamp_precision: inferred from CSV representation; minute precision retained as interval, not subsecond truth
session_rules.source: explicit source_file_id -> provenance_domain_id registry; no tuple-only merging across unrelated domains
session_rules.source_file_identity: dataset + relative path; content hashes and archive integrity are separately verified
session_rules.same_raw_observation: deduplicate identical timestamp+raw-hash across different source files in same domain only; repeated observation within same file retained
session_rules.duplicates: cross-label identical model-input groups all excluded; same-label content and session-association edges unioned before partition
session_rules.overflow: no partial search accepted; spill/chunk or stop affected domain with explicit unresolved status
session_rules.truncation: verified complete-record prefix only under declared coverage; original preserved; any CSV time-uncertainty interval touching unavailable coverage rejected; no full-capture claim
session_rules.nonfinite_features: fixed zero replacement, counted explicitly; malformed nonnumeric statistics rejected
session_rules.scope: IPv4 TCP/UDP in current adapter; unsupported families/links explicitly rejected or block search completeness
